newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Cultus sees new Cornea oil indications.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Cultus sees new Cornea oil indications.

text.p: Cultus Petroleum NL said on Thursday its Cornea-2 ST1 sidetrack well in the the Browse Basin offshore Western Australia had shown oil indications in the form of strong fluorescence.

"Although logging is continuing and more information is to be collected, Cultus believes it is probable that the thickness of the oil column seen in Cornea-1 and 1B will increase in Cornea-2 ST1," the company told the Australian Stock Exchange.
Shares in Cultus have risen sharply since January 31 when it said drill results from the Cornea-1 and 1B wells pointed to an oil discovery.
Cultus later reported an estimated oil column in excess of 20 metres with an associated gas cap.
Permit WA-241-P is operated by Royal Dutch/Shell unit Shell Development (Australia) Pty Ltd with 50 percent, while Cultus and Chevron Corp unit Chevron Asiatic Ltd each hold 25 percent.
Cultus said the wireline logging programme is continuing.
